description: This Java class implements a bootstrap security store for LwM2M protocol in Thingsboard, managing bootstrap configurations, security info, and session handling.

classes.name: LwM2MBootstrapSecurityStore
classes.description: A class implementing BootstrapSecurityStore for managing LwM2M bootstrap security configurations, sessions, and validation.

methods.name: getAllByEndpoint
methods.description: Retrieves all security info entries for a given endpoint.

methods.name: getByIdentity
methods.description: Retrieves security info by identity, updates bootstrap config if available.

methods.name: getByOscoreIdentity
methods.description: Stub method returning null for OscoreIdentity.

methods.name: getX509ByEndpoint
methods.description: Retrieves X509 security info for an endpoint.

methods.name: setBootstrapConfigSecurityInfo
methods.description: Sets bootstrap configuration security info into the store.

methods.name: getParametersBootstrap
methods.description: Gets bootstrap parameters and validates security mode.

methods.name: getValidatedSecurityMode
methods.description: Validates that bootstrap and lwm2m server security modes are synchronized.

methods.name: getSessionByEndpoint
methods.description: Returns session info for an endpoint.

methods.name: removeSessionByEndpoint
methods.description: Removes session info for an endpoint.

methods.name: getBootstrapConfigByEndpoint
methods.description: Retrieves bootstrap config for an endpoint.

methods.name: addValueToStore
methods.description: Adds security info and bootstrap config to store, updating bootstrap configurations.
